tasks.title: Configure Supabase Auth and Prisma Profile Schema
tasks.description: Set up Supabase Auth for email/password, configure environment variables, and define the Prisma 'Profile' model with 'Role' enum, then apply database migrations.
tasks.details:
1. Install `@supabase/ssr` and ensure `lib/supabase/server.ts`, `lib/supabase/client.ts`, `lib/supabase/middleware.ts` are correctly configured to initialize Supabase clients.
2. In Supabase dashboard, enable Email/Password authentication and whitelist necessary redirect URLs.
3. Add environment variables: `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`.
4. Update `prisma/schema.prisma` to include the `Profile` model with fields: `id`, `userId` (unique, linked to Supabase auth.users.id), `email` (unique), `fullName`, `role` (enum: `SCIENTIST`, `EMPLOYER`, `COLLABORATOR`, `ADMIN`), `bio`, `skills`, `experience`, `cvUrl`, `avatarUrl`, `institution`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`.
5. Define the `Role` enum in `schema.prisma`.
6. Run `npx prisma migrate dev --name auth-profiles` to apply schema changes and `npx prisma generate` to update Prisma Client types.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Verify Supabase project settings reflect Email/Password auth enabled and redirect URLs configured.
2. Write a simple test script or manually verify `lib/supabase/server.ts` and `lib/supabase/client.ts` can initialize and connect to Supabase.
3. Check the database directly to confirm the `profiles` table and `Role` enum are created as per the schema.

tasks.title: Implement Sign Up Flow with Role Selection
tasks.description: Develop the user sign-up form, integrate with Supabase for user creation, and create a corresponding Prisma profile with role selection.
tasks.details:
1. Create `app/(auth)/signup/page.tsx` as a Server Component.
2. Develop `authesci-app/components/modules/auth/SignUpForm.tsx` (Client Component) with fields for name, email, password, institution (optional), and a `authesci-app/components/modules/auth/RoleSelector.tsx` for 'Scientist' or 'Employer'.
3. Implement client-side form validation: email format, password strength (min 8 chars, 1 uppercase, 1 number, 1 special), full name (min 2 chars), role required.
4. Create `authesci-app/app/actions/auth.ts` and implement the `signUp()` Server Action.
5. Inside `signUp()`:
   a. Call `Supabase.auth.signUp({ email, password })`.
   b. If successful, call `Prisma.profile.create({ data: { userId: supabaseUser.id, email, fullName, role, institution } })`.
   c. Redirect the user to `/verify-email`.
6. Integrate toast notifications (Task 9) for success/error messages.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Attempt to sign up with valid credentials and verify a new user is created in Supabase `auth.users` and a corresponding profile in Prisma `profiles` with the correct role.
2. Test all validation rules (invalid email, weak password, missing name/role) and ensure appropriate error messages are displayed.
3. Verify redirection to `/verify-email` after successful signup.
4. Check for toast notifications on success and failure.

tasks.title: Implement Email Verification (OTP)
tasks.description: Create the email verification page where users enter a 6-digit OTP sent by Supabase to confirm their account.
tasks.details:
1. Create `app/(auth)/verify-email/page.tsx`.
2. Develop `authesci-app/components/modules/auth/VerifyEmailForm.tsx` (Client Component) with an input for the 6-digit OTP.
3. In `authesci-app/app/actions/auth.ts`, implement the `verifyOTP()` Server Action.
4. Inside `verifyOTP()`:
   a. Call `Supabase.auth.verifyOtp({ email, token, type: 'email' })`.
   b. On success, redirect the user to `/dashboard/[role]` (role determined by fetching Prisma profile).
   c. On failure, display an error message and provide a 'Resend Code' option.
5. Implement a countdown timer for the 'Resend Code' button.
6. Integrate toast notifications (Task 9) for success/error messages.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Sign up a new user (Task 2) and verify an OTP email is received.
2. Enter a valid OTP and confirm successful verification and redirection to the appropriate dashboard.
3. Enter an invalid OTP and verify an error message is shown.
4. Test the 'Resend Code' functionality and ensure a new OTP email is sent.
5. Verify toast notifications for all scenarios.

tasks.title: Implement Login Flow with Role-Based Redirect
tasks.description: Develop the user login form, authenticate credentials with Supabase, fetch the user's Prisma profile, and redirect to their role-specific dashboard.
tasks.details:
1. Create `app/(auth)/login/page.tsx`.
2. Develop `authesci-app/components/modules/auth/LoginForm.tsx` (Client Component) with email, password inputs, 'Remember Me' checkbox, and 'Forgot Password' link.
3. In `authesci-app/app/actions/auth.ts`, implement the `login()` Server Action.
4. Inside `login()`:
   a. Call `Supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password })`.
   b. If successful, fetch the user's Prisma profile using `Prisma.profile.findUnique({ where: { userId: supabaseUser.id } })` to get their `role`.
   c. Redirect the user to `/dashboard/${profile.role.toLowerCase()}`.
   d. Handle cases for unverified email (show warning with resend link).
5. Implement 'Remember Me' functionality to extend session duration (Supabase handles this via `signInWithPassword` options).
6. Integrate toast notifications (Task 9) for success/error messages.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Log in with valid credentials for different roles (Scientist, Employer) and verify redirection to the correct role-specific dashboard.
2. Attempt to log in with invalid credentials and verify error messages.
3. Test 'Remember Me' functionality by closing and reopening the browser.
4. Test login with an unverified email and ensure the warning and resend link appear.
5. Verify toast notifications for all scenarios.

tasks.title: Implement Forgot/Reset Password Flow
tasks.description: Create the 'Forgot Password' and 'Reset Password' pages and server actions to allow users to recover their accounts.
tasks.details:
1. Create `app/(auth)/forgot-password/page.tsx` and `authesci-app/components/modules/auth/ForgotPasswordForm.tsx`.
2. In `authesci-app/app/actions/auth.ts`, implement `requestPasswordReset()` Server Action:
   a. Call `Supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, { redirectTo: `${NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/auth/reset-password` })`.
   b. Display a success message indicating an email has been sent.
3. Create `app/(auth)/reset-password/page.tsx` (which will receive a `token` in URL params) and `authesci-app/components/modules/auth/ResetPasswordForm.tsx`.
4. In `authesci-app/app/actions/auth.ts`, implement `resetPassword()` Server Action:
   a. Extract the `token` from the URL.
   b. Call `Supabase.auth.updateUser({ password: newPassword })`.
   c. On success, redirect to `/login`.
5. Configure custom Supabase email template for password reset (if Task 8 is completed, otherwise use default).
6. Integrate toast notifications (Task 9) for success/error messages.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Request a password reset for a registered email and verify the reset email is received with a valid link.
2. Click the reset link, navigate to the reset password page, and successfully set a new password.
3. Attempt to log in with the new password.
4. Test with an invalid or expired reset token.
5. Verify toast notifications for all scenarios.

tasks.title: Implement Route Protection Middleware
tasks.description: Develop a Next.js middleware to protect specified routes, ensuring only authenticated users can access them, and manage session refreshing.
tasks.details:
1. Create or update `authesci-app/middleware.ts`.
2. Utilize the `lib/supabase/middleware.ts` client to check for a valid Supabase session.
3. Implement logic within `middleware.ts`:
   a. If no valid session is found and the request is for a protected route, redirect to `/login`.
   b. If a session exists, allow the request to continue and refresh the session if it's nearing expiration.
4. Configure the `matcher` in `middleware.ts` to protect routes: `/dashboard/*`, `/profile/*`, `/jobs/*/apply`, `/projects/*`.
5. Ensure session refresh logic prevents hydration errors on client-side.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Attempt to access a protected route (`/dashboard/scientist`, `/profile`) while unauthenticated and verify redirection to `/login`.
2. Log in and access protected routes, ensuring they load correctly.
3. Simulate an expired session (e.g., by manually manipulating cookies or waiting) and verify the session is refreshed automatically or the user is redirected to login if refresh fails.
4. Check console for hydration errors.

tasks.title: Implement Logout Functionality
tasks.description: Add a logout button that clears the user's session and redirects them to the login page.
tasks.details:
1. Add a logout button/link to a relevant component, e.g., `authesci-app/components/modules/dashboard/UserMenu.tsx`.
2. In `authesci-app/app/actions/auth.ts`, implement the `logout()` Server Action.
3. Inside `logout()`:
   a. Call `Supabase.auth.signOut()`.
   b. Clear any client-side session cookies if necessary (Supabase usually handles this).
   c. Redirect the user to `/login`.
4. Integrate toast notifications (Task 9) for logout confirmation.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Log in, then click the logout button and verify redirection to `/login`.
2. After logging out, attempt to access a protected route and confirm redirection to `/login`.
3. Verify that the session is completely cleared (e.g., by checking browser cookies or Supabase session state).
4. Check for toast notification on successful logout.

tasks.title: Integrate Custom Email Service (Hostinger SMTP)
tasks.description: Set up Nodemailer to send transactional emails (verification, password reset, welcome) via Hostinger SMTP with custom templates.
tasks.details:
1. Install `nodemailer` and `@types/nodemailer`.
2. Add Hostinger SMTP credentials to `.env.local`: `SMTP_HOST`, `SMTP_PORT`, `SMTP_USER`, `SMTP_PASSWORD`.
3. Create `authesci-app/lib/mail.ts` to configure and export a Nodemailer transporter using these SMTP credentials.
4. Create an `authesci-app/app/api/mail/route.ts` (API Route) to handle sending emails, which can be called from Server Actions.
5. Develop custom HTML and text email templates in an `authesci-app/emails/` folder for: Welcome Email, OTP Verification, Password Reset, Password Changed.
6. Modify relevant Server Actions (e.g., `signUp`, `requestPasswordReset`) to trigger these custom emails instead of relying solely on Supabase's default email sending, or use Supabase hooks to trigger custom emails.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Send a test email using the configured Nodemailer transporter to verify SMTP connection and email delivery.
2. Trigger signup, password reset, and email verification flows and confirm that custom branded emails are received in the inbox, not spam.
3. Verify that email templates render correctly with dynamic data.

tasks.title: Implement Toast Notifications
tasks.description: Integrate Shadcn/UI toast components to display success, error, and info messages for all authentication actions.
tasks.details:
1. Ensure Shadcn/UI toast components are installed and configured.
2. Add the `<Toaster />` component to `app/layout.tsx` (root layout).
3. Create a helper function in `lib/utils.ts` (e.g., `showToast(type, message)`) to simplify displaying toasts.
4. Integrate toast calls into all authentication Server Actions (e.g., `signUp()`, `login()`, `verifyOTP()`, `requestPasswordReset()`, `resetPassword()`, `logout()`) to provide user feedback.
5. Configure toasts to auto-dismiss after 5 seconds and support different types (success, error, info, warning).
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Perform all authentication actions (signup, login, verify, forgot password, reset password, logout) and verify that toasts appear for all success and error scenarios.
2. Test both success and error scenarios for each action.
3. Ensure toasts auto-dismiss and display correct styling for different types.
4. Verify accessibility of toast messages.

tasks.title: Develop Role-Specific Dashboard Placeholders
tasks.description: Create basic placeholder pages for each user role's dashboard to ensure successful redirection after login and email verification.
tasks.details:
1. Create the following Server Component pages:
   a. `authesci-app/app/dashboard/scientist/page.tsx`
   b. `authesci-app/app/dashboard/employer/page.tsx`
   c. `authesci-app/app/dashboard/collaborator/page.tsx`
   d. `authesci-app/app/dashboard/admin/page.tsx`
2. Each page should display a simple 'Welcome, [User Role]!' message and potentially a 'Complete your profile' prompt.
3. Ensure these pages can fetch the current user's session and profile data to display their specific role and name.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Log in as a Scientist, Employer, and verify redirection to `/dashboard/scientist` and `/dashboard/employer` respectively.
2. After email verification, ensure users are redirected to their correct role-based dashboard.
3. Verify that each dashboard page correctly displays the user's role and a welcome message.
